manual_browser_checks: Streamlit local health endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8502/_stcore/health returned HTTP 200.
Submitted an empty form; the page showed the required-skill-or-CV validation message and stayed on step 1.
Entered synthetic experience-only evidence plus misspelled postgress; review showed a PostgreSQL suggestion, and the spelling changed only after explicit selection.
Confirmed known experience skills; summary displayed their source and kept unknown CustomSkill out of role fit and resource suggestions.
Pasted a synthetic CV, supplied skills, interests, experience and a four-skill JD; summary showed 50.0%, matched python/sql and missing tableau/excel.
Selected Data Analyst; role suggestions showed the interest match as a reason while the separate skill fit stayed skill-only, consistent with module tests.
Viewed the Data Analyst weekly roadmap diagram: four priority cards with skills, resource/practice counts, caveat indicators and week arrows.
Created six Data Analyst interview questions, equal to the role bank limit; the UI says answers are not automatically scored.
Loaded and confirmed the synthetic Sales profile; the roadmap showed practice-first tasks for customer prospecting, teamwork, problem solving and time management.
AppTest covered PDF/DOCX upload parsing and additional rejection/recovery cases; no private CV was used in browser checks.
known_limits: All 187 formerly unreviewed resource mappings were adjudicated: 126 partial, 49 unsuitable and 12 blocked; no remaining unreviewed mapping in that set. Blocked sources require a specific accessible source to revisit.
Resource content review is a local evidence audit, not independent expert/legal accreditation. Partial resources require role-specific practice and remain caveated.
The question bank has 752 questions, but only 6 have internal review evidence, 12 are templates and 734 are unreviewed; there is no independent question-bank review.
JD parsing recognizes exact catalog terms across the full text and asks the user to confirm them; it does not semantically interpret every requirement, qualification or nuance.
Experience text contributes only catalog-recognized skills after user confirmation; the app does not infer tenure, proficiency or employer-fit from free prose.
Interest affects exploratory role suggestions (20% when combined; interest-only suggestions are capped at 20/100); it does not increase the separate skill-match percentage.
The local browser check used synthetic data and desktop layout. This is not release readiness, mobile support, accessibility certification, remote CI or independent UX review.

unreviewed labor-law and tax-law records return no recommendations
